evidence.reason: No benchmark against held-out storm events or independent shoreline observations

stratifiedOffshoreEvidence.limitations: High-wave >=1m is a descriptive stratification boundary, NOT a storm-warning or beach safety threshold. Nearby buoy forecasts are not Agate shoreline waves.

caveat: Offshore model vs buoy at NDBC 45004 only. Not Agate Beach surf, harbor conditions or stone exposure. A small single-cycle sample is not calibrated model skill. NOAA issue time does not establish actual release time.
